answer.justification: The patient has antibiotic-associated Clostridioides difficile colitis due to spore-forming gram-positive anaerobic rods. C. difficile spores resist alcohol and quaternary ammonium disinfectants. Chlorine-based (bleach) solutions are sporicidal and recommended for environmental disinfection to prevent transmission to subsequent patients.
